eslint.config.mjs: The lint rules themselves. eslint loads this, and the `lint` step in .github/workflows/js-unit-suite.yml is the gate on it.
tools/lissajous_page.js: tools/lissajous.html's entry module. Importing it builds the page: it calls bootstrapTool() at the top level, which stands up a WebGL scene the fake DOM cannot provide. Its math is tests/lissajous_math.test.js's subject, and the page itself is covered by scripts/browser-smoke.mjs.
main.js: index.html's entry module, whose body is `void bootstrap()`. Importing it starts the simulator, which is why bootstrap.js stays separately importable and tests/bootstrap.test.js covers it there.
vendor-importmap.js: An IIFE the page loads by script tag, not a module. tests/vendor-importmap.test.js evaluates its source in a node:vm sandbox, which is not a module load.
scripts/browser-smoke.mjs: Drives headless Chrome over every manifest-served page. It is its own CI job (.github/workflows/browser-smoke.yml), and there is no part of it a unit test could reach without a browser.
scripts/workbench-probe.mjs: Drives the shader workbench's pipeline strip with a real mouse in headless Chrome, which is the whole point of it: the fake DOM the unit suite renders into has neither layout nor pointer capture. It is a job of its own in .github/workflows/browser-smoke.yml.
scripts/panel-probe.mjs: Drives the effect panel's scroll and focus restoration in headless Chrome, which no unit test can reach: tests/fake_dom.js has no layout, so its scrollTop is a plain expando rather than an offset clamped to the scrollable extent. It is a job of its own in .github/workflows/browser-smoke.yml.
scripts/solids-probe.mjs: Drags an op row of the solids tool in headless Chrome with a real mouse and a real finger, neither of which tests/fake_dom.js can produce: it models no layout for the drop slot to be read from, no pointer capture for the gesture to ride on, and no CSS for touch-action to be read from. It is a job of its own in .github/workflows/browser-smoke.yml.
scripts/generate-shader-v2-documents.mjs: Regenerates the committed v2 pattern documents and digest_migration.v1v2.json from the v1 fixtures on import, so a test load would rewrite the working tree. Its output is what tests/shader_document.test.js pins: the byte-identical re-export gate and the migration-table completeness case fail if the committed files drift from what a rerun would write.
scripts/generate-importmap.mjs: tests/generate_importmap.test.js and tests/vendor-importmap.test.js run it for real, but against a copy inside a throwaway fixture repo, so the module the loader resolves is the copy rather than this path.
scripts/run-tests.mjs: tests/run_tests.test.js drives it as a subprocess against a fixture repo, so the loader resolves the fixture invocation rather than this path.
scripts/record-module-loads.mjs: Loaded through NODE_OPTIONS before its own loader hook exists; a missing recorder leaves source modules uncovered and fails the roster gate.
